items.summary: A path traversal flaw in Termix-SSH Termix up to 2.9.2 lets an attacker manipulate the destPath argument of the file-manager transferToHost endpoint to write files outside the intended directory. Published 2 November 2026.

A Linux kernel flaw in IPv4 checksum handling for virtio-net lets an untrusted VM guest overwrite two bytes of an already-validated IPv4 header on the host, escaping the guest — dubbed PwnEscape. The bug dates to kernel 2.6.27; fixed kernels and KernelCare livepatches are available.

Keycloak's SAML HTTP-Redirect binding processes percent-encoded parameter names (such as %53AMLResponse) while signature verification uses a different form, allowing an attacker to bypass SAML signature checks. Published 5 November 2026.

The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 writes an unvalidated request header into a PHP file it regenerates on an unprotected admin hook, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution when its custom database error page is enabled. Published 7 November 2026.

OpenHuman before 0.57.13 converts a remote direct message received through a configured Yuanbao channel into a generic channel agent message without proper validation, enabling code injection. Fixed in version 0.57.13; published 5 November 2026.
